statements.status_notes: Improper input validation in io.netty.handler.codec.dns.DnsCodecUtil's encodeDomainName / decodeDomainName. The netty-codec-dns jar is embedded only inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). Stargate resolves Cassandra contact-point hostnames via the JVM default resolver (java.net.InetAddress); the Cassandra Java driver does not enable netty-resolver-dns by default and Stargate never wires DnsNameResolver into the driver configuration. Neither DnsCodecUtil entry point is reachable from inbound or outbound traffic. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
